requirements.title: Program the greeting and introduction with the referee
requirements.text: The referee asks for the names of the players before the game and announces them. How do we program this?

requirements.title: Program the racket controls
requirements.text: The first player can control their racket using the W and S keys, and the second player can control theirs using the up and down arrows.

requirements.title: Counting missed balls
requirements.text: Find the Goal Check procedure and program it.

requirements.title: Describe the victory check
requirements.text: Find the Win Check procedure and program it.

media.title: Ping-pong
media.text: This is a 2 player game. Who will win? The first player can control their racket using the W and S keys, and the second player can control theirs using the up and down arrows.
